catalog.responseRule: The canonical identity registry contains exactly 98 nodes; each response is the current authorized and deployed subset after server-side eligibility intersection.
catalog.routeKeyRule: hris.explorer.<sourceNodeKey with dots replaced by hyphens>
catalog.labelKeyRule: hris.explorer.routes.<sourceNodeKey with dots replaced by hyphens>
catalog.labelRule: All 98 keys require explicit ko and en values; collision or absence fails closed.

typedOwnerEvidence.rule: Each provider returns authorization-filtered typed metadata plus verified owner scope and source revision evidence. Missing, stale, mismatched or failed evidence cannot become an authorized item and degrades the projection to PARTIAL.

persistence.isolation: Verified tenant and authenticated principal on every operation with RLS enabled and forced.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: SYS-API-027/038/039/040 implement the exact pushed paths, query/header requirements, statuses, closed schemas and dual receipt-profile union without local shadow DTO drift.
The canonical registry is exactly 76 BASE76 plus 22 MODERN22 nodes with 98 unique stable route keys and 98 explicit ko/en label pairs; collisions or missing labels fail closed.

Every response node is reauthorized against the deployed exact PAGE route, APP.HCM, shell-reader duty, tenant configuration, country pack, owner scope and current field policy; raw IA lifecycle and client role lists never grant access.

HRIS_INTERNAL targets satisfy the exact allowed HCM PAGE decision and DWP_CONTROL targets use only literal sealed paths; generic /admin authorization and the five undeployed external targets are absent.
Tenant and principal are server-bound, all four tables enforce enabled and forced RLS, and cross-tenant or out-of-origin receipt access is opaque without data disclosure.

Preferences preserve at most 20 unique ordered favorites, require If-Match CAS and Idempotency-Key, replay exact requests, reject digest reuse and purge retired or denied keys in the same transaction.
Recents preserve at most 20 unique authorized keys using server-time LRU and 30-day TTL, replay exact idempotent requests and purge expired, unknown or denied keys.

Explorer commands use the shared sys_hris_command_receipts store; exact replay is stable, mismatched reuse has no side effect, and RESULT_UNKNOWN is reconciled only through the exact originating-context receipt route.

Typed owner-evidence providers expose only minimized fields, reject missing/stale/mismatched scope evidence, never query another service database, and return PARTIAL rather than a false empty success when any registered provider fails.
Work Explorer mounts only at the governed hcm.utility /hr/explore route and one exact-authorized Home secondary action; seven workbenches remain unchanged and HrisProductMap is not mounted or reused.

The search-first UI preserves useful query/filter/selection state in the URL and proves loading, success, authorized-empty, search-empty, 403, 409, stale, partial, result-unknown and retryable states with keyboard, visible focus, long ko/en labels, light/dark, high contrast and reduced motion.

V327 passes clean and V326-to-V327 upgrade with historical checksums unchanged; targeted responsive and 200-percent zoom evidence passes; only allowed paths change; v43 and runtime remain DRAFT/default OFF with no activation claim.
